name: Counter-Strike 2
policy_notice: Valve officially confirmed that Counter-Strike 2 will NOT be released on macOS (FAQ Oct 2023). It executes via compatibility layers (CrossOver/GPTK). Multiplayer matchmaking with VAC experiences frequent session authentication drops ('VAC was unable to verify your game session'); permanent ban risk under Wine remains officially unverified.
sources: Valve Steam Support: Counter-Strike 2 macOS Deprecation Notice (October 2023)
MacRumors: Valve Drops Support for Counter-Strike 2 on Mac (October 2023)
